title: MT41025: Non Destructive Testing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite - NilIntroduction: Aims, visual inspection, basic
techniques.Liquid penetrant testing: the method, effect of surface tension,
applications.Magnetic Particle Testing: types of magnetization, equipment used,
demagnetization. Industrial Radiography: generation of X-rays, isotope sources,
properties of X- and gamma rays. Contrast, film characteristics and Image
quality indicators, Ultrasonic testing: Acoustic impedance, pulse echo, through
transmission and resonance techniques. Probes employed. Oblique incidence. Beam
characteristics. Flaw size determination, types of scan.Eddy current technique:
principles, equipment, applications.Acoustic emission: Introduction,
methodology and equipment. Other techniques: Thermal imaging, neutron
radiography, holographic techniques, etc. Case studies.NDT in structural health
monitoring. NDTin microstructural characterization and mechanical propery
evaluation . Standards and codes. Text Books: 1. Baldev Raj, T. Jayakumar, and
M. Thavasimuthu: Practical Non-destructive Testing,
Narosa Publishing
House, New Delhi, 2002. 2.ASM Handbook, Non-destructive evaluation and quality
control, Vol.17, ASM
International, Materials Park, Ohio, USA.
